name: Issue & Project link check

# Mechanical gate (CI side): every PR into main must reference an existing
# GitHub issue (e.g. "Closes #12", "Refs #12"), and that issue must be an
# item in the "World Capitals Map" Project (#5). This is the CI counterpart
# to the local commit-msg hook (scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg) — see
# .github/copilot-instructions.md "Task tracking" for the full rule.

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, reopened, synchronize]
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  issues: read

jobs:
  check-issue-link:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Extract linked issue number
        id: extract
        env:
          PR_BODY: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}
          PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
        run: |
          TEXT="$PR_TITLE
          $PR_BODY"
          ISSUE_NUM=$(echo "$TEXT" | grep -oiE '(closes|fixes|refs?|resolves)[[:space:]]*#[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)
          if [ -z "$ISSUE_NUM" ]; then
            ISSUE_NUM=$(echo "$TEXT" | grep -oE '#[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)
          fi
          if [ -z "$ISSUE_NUM" ]; then
            echo "::error::PR title/body does not reference any GitHub issue (e.g. 'Closes #12'). Every task must have a tracked issue before merging. See .github/copilot-instructions.md."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "issue_num=$ISSUE_NUM" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Verify issue exists
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          gh issue view "${{ steps.extract.outputs.issue_num }}" \
            --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
            --json number,title,state >/dev/null

      - name: Verify issue is tracked in the Project
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PROJECT_GH_TOKEN }}
          ISSUE_NUM: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.issue_num }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            echo "::warning::PROJECT_GH_TOKEN secret not configured (needs 'project' scope) — skipping Project membership check. Configure this secret to fully enforce the gate."
            exit 0
          fi
          gh project item-list 5 --owner asasar --format json > /tmp/project-items.json
          FOUND=$(python3 scripts/ci/check-issue-in-project.py /tmp/project-items.json "$ISSUE_NUM")
          if [ "$FOUND" != "yes" ]; then
            ISSUE_URL="https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/issues/${ISSUE_NUM}"
            echo "::error::Issue #${ISSUE_NUM} is not an item in the 'World Capitals Map' Project (#5). Run: gh project item-add 5 --owner asasar --url $ISSUE_URL"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Issue #${ISSUE_NUM} confirmed in Project #5."
